findings.message: The rename variant the previous round named is not fixed or tested. `_fix_touched` runs `git diff -U0 base..HEAD -- <finding file>` with only the old path as pathspec, so git cannot pair the rename. A renamed file shows as a whole-file deletion hunk (`-1,N +0,0`), and any finding line within 1..N+3 counts as touched. A pure `git mv` with no content change therefore marks the finding as covered and drops it. The finding's code still exists under the new path, so it should be carried. Fix: resolve the file's current path with `git diff -M --name-status base..HEAD`, compare the hunks of the renamed pair, and carry the finding when the contents are unchanged. The test table also has no rename row. The two other rows the previous round asked for, an unrelated edit and two findings in one file, are covered by the `fp8` row.
findings.scenario: Finding a.py:2. Expected: carried, because the lines were not changed.
